messages:
noah: Running the node quickstart but hitting two things: TLS cert error then a 402 about billing.
noah: `curl https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/firstcall -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` -> `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`
noah: If I do `curl --insecure` the body is `{"error":"workspace_pending_billing","message":"workspace needs billing setup"}` but dashboard shows payment method attached.
rita: common duo: corp MITM CA + wrong token pointing at another org. Run `curl https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/whoami -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` to confirm org.
noah: whoami -> `{ "org_id": "org_personal_900", "email": "noah@home" }` but our team org is `org_team_900`. Crap, grabbed personal token.
cheng: for TLS, prefer adding internal CA to truststore or use `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` for node: `export NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/path/to/corp-ca.pem`. Docs should avoid suggesting `--insecure`.
noah: swapped token and set NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS; quickstart now returns 200. thanks!
devex-bot: Docs action: create a short "validate token/org (whoami)" step at top of quickstart; add troubleshooting note for corporate proxies and env var examples.
noah: I'll open GH issue and PR the doc change with `whoami` snippet and CI note. tagging @cheng for CA instructions.
